versions.changelog:
- Initial release of the html-css-to-image skill.
- Allows agents to generate images and PDFs from HTML/CSS, capture live website screenshots, and use reusable templates via the HCTI MCP tools.
- Requires connection to an HCTI account using OAuth through the OpenClaw MCP server.
- Supports operations for creating images, capturing webpages, managing templates, and handling batch rendering.
- Includes clear guidelines for authorization, safety, and error handling.
